topics.headline: [Production Benchmarks](/evals/openai-production-benchmarks) not_unsafe across violent/nonviolent illicit, extremism, hate, gore, sexual categories

source.quote: We conducted benchmark evaluations across disallowed content categories.

topics.headline: sexual/minors Production Benchmark plus age-appropriate protections for users believed under 18

source.quote:
For
users we believe may be under 18, we apply additional age-appropriate content protections that
further restrict sexual content and exposure to gore.

topics.headline: self-harm (standard) Production Benchmark and dynamic self-harm mental-health eval
Multiturn jailbreak robustness evaluated; results directional with regression from GPT-5.3 Instant (Figure 1)

source.quote:
We evaluate model robustness to jailbreaks: adversarial prompts designed to circumvent safety
guardrails and elicit harmful assistance.

topics.headline: [Prompt injection attacks in connectors](/evals/openai-prompt-injection-connectors): gpt-5.5-instant 0.99 not_unsafe (higher is better)
Factuality Heavy, User Flagged Failures, and High Stakes hallucination rates; Instant improves vs GPT-5.3 Instant (Figure 2)

source.quote:
We find that GPT-5.5 Instant has significant improvements
on factuality over GPT-5.3-instant on each of these prompt sets, particularly on high stakes
domains.

GPT-5.5 Instant scored 0.0101 on this metric, broadly comparable to
GPT-5.2-instant and GPT-5.3-instant.

topics.headline: Treated as High cybersecurity capability; capture the flag (CTF), [CVE-Bench](/evals/cve-bench), cyber range; Combined Pass Rate 76.9%

source.quote:
we similarly treat GPT-5.5 Instant as High under the Preparedness
Framework.

topics.headline: Treated as High Biological and Chemical capability; wet-lab and tacit-knowledge evals plus bio safeguards

source.quote:
We are treating this launch as High capability in the Biological and Chemical domain, activating
the associated Preparedness safeguards.

We evaluated models on a tacit knowledge and troubleshooting multiple choice dataset created
with Gryphon Scientific.

findings.text: This is the first Instant model treated as High in Cybersecurity and Biological & Chemical Preparedness, with matching safeguards applied.

source.quote:
this is the
first Instant model that we are treating as High capability in our Cybersecurity and Biological &
Chemical Preparedness categories, and implementing appropriate safeguards.

findings.text: Statistically significant regressions vs GPT-5.3 Instant on gore and disallowed sexual content; extra system-level sexual mitigations and under-18 protections are applied.

source.quote:
comparable (i.e., not statistically significantly different) to the
previous production model (GPT-5.3 Instant) on all disallowed categories with the exception of
gore and disallowed sexual content.

findings.text: Jailbreak results show a regression from GPT-5.3 Instant and are presented as directional interim results only (Figure 1 has no extractable numbers).

source.quote:
view these results, including the
regression from GPT-5.3-Instant, as directional rather than definitive.

findings.text: GPT-5.5 Instant improves [HealthBench](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.08775), HealthBench Hard, and HealthBench Professional vs GPT-5.3 Instant after length adjustment; Consensus is flat.

source.quote: GPT-5.5 Instant improves over GPT-5.3 Instant on HealthBench (+1.8), HealthBench Hard

findings.text: Cyber High classification uses xhigh reasoning elicitation; the Instant model is deployed at low reasoning effort and scores below GPT-5.5 Thinking on cyber evals.

source.quote:
Note that GPT-5.5 Instant is
deployed at a low reasoning effort, and even at xhigh reasoning effort it still performs lower than
GPT-5.5 Thinking on these evaluations.

findings.text: Model-alone biological safety on Synthetic Data (Hard) drops to 0.48 for Instant vs ~0.8–0.9 for Thinking models; monitors raise it to 0.92.

[Cyber range](/evals/openai-cyber-range) Combined Pass Rate is 76.9% for Instant vs 92.3% for GPT-5.5 Thinking; Instant fails Basic C2, certificate authority (CA)/DNS Hijacking, and endpoint detection and response (EDR) Evasion.

source.quote:
GPT-5.5 Instant fails three scenarios – Basic Command and Control, CA/DNS Hijakcing,
and EDR Evasion

findings.text: AI Self-Improvement capability evals were not run; Instant is judged below High based on being less capable than GPT-5.5 Thinking.

source.quote:
AI Self-Improvement capability evals were not run, as GPT-5.5 Instant is less capable than
GPT-5.5 Thinking across several intelligence evaluations.

GPT-5.3 Instant mapped to openai/gpt-5.3-chat; GPT-5.5 Thinking / gpt-5.5-thinking to openai/gpt-5.5; gpt-5.4-thinking to openai/gpt-5.4. Cyber capability tables (CTF/CVE) state pass@k and trial counts but give no numeric scores outside Figure 7/8. Cover and TOC share printed page 1; pageCount is 21 PDF pages with content.
